about: Published tools run on iscc output before the paper regime: the executed tool tutorials of 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-27 (notebooks/tool_*.ipynb and notebooks/assay_scrna.ipynb). Every value is copied from a printed notebook output; nothing was re-run. The datasets were generated by validation/make_analysis_data.py on 2026-08-26/27 with the 'realistic' regime at the 'mid' scale; analysis_data/manifest.json records no iscc version.

rows.metric: clone copy number within one copy of the truth
rows.source: notebooks/tool_hmmcopy_R.ipynb, cell 13: 'within 1 copy of the truth: 96% of (clone, segment) entries'

notebooks/tool_scite_trees.ipynb, cell 7: 'recall 0.91' (96 of 106 true pairs); the stored output predates the cell's current code and prints 'no pair was ordered BACKWARDS: False', so some pairs were ordered backwards and their number is not recorded
rows.dataset: analysis_data/dna/scite (seed 3), 20 mutations x 200 cells, dropout 0.2, false positive 0.01

rows.metric: cellular prevalence against true cancer-cell fraction (Pearson r)
rows.source: notebooks/tool_pyclonevi.ipynb, cell 9: 'cellular prevalence vs true CCF: Pearson r 0.96 Spearman 0.55'

rows.metric: mutation clusters against true clonal groups (ARI)
rows.source: notebooks/tool_pyclonevi.ipynb, cell 9: 'clustering vs true clone: ARI 0.73'

rows.metric: planted precedences among the two strongest effects
rows.source: notebooks/tool_treemhn_R.ipynb, cell 5: 'both planted edges in the top 2 of 12'; derived: 2 of 2 planted edges in the top 2; the expected share under a random ranking of 12 entries is 2/12
rows.dataset: analysis_data/treemhn (seed 3), 36 patients, 4 events, trees from SCITE
analysis_data/clonealign (seed 6), 1,501 cells, 4 clones, copy number called by HMMcopy

rows.source: notebooks/assay_scrna.ipynb, cell 27: 'malignant-vs-normal AUC : 0.964' (infercnvpy, the scverse reimplementation)
rows.dataset: the tutorial tumour, 800 malignant and 300 normal cells, 10x protocol

rows.metric: segment copy number, single cells (mean r)

rows.source: notebooks/assay_scrna.ipynb, cell 27: 'clone-level r (segments with real CN variation): 0.827'
notebooks/tool_numbat_R.ipynb, cell 5: 'malignant-vs-normal AUC 0.977'; cell 3 also prints 'Expression noise level (MSE): high (4.9)'
rows.dataset: analysis_data/numbat (seed 3), 1,677 cells (1,527 malignant, 150 normal); the 150 normal cells are also the expression reference

rows.metric: communication probability of the wired pair
rows.source: notebooks/tool_cellchat_R.ipynb, cell 7: 'rank 1 of 250 scored', 'probability: 0.378 (best decoy 0.227)'; cell 10: strongest edge immune to stromal, the wired direction
rows.dataset: analysis_data/cci (seed 3), 4,000 cells, 250 candidate pairs; run stamped 2026-08-27

rows.source: notebooks/tool_rctd_R.ipynb, cell 5: 'mean per-type r: 0.974' (cancer 0.979, immune 0.967, stromal 0.977)
rows.dataset: analysis_data/rctd (seed 3), 2,542 spots; the reference is scRNA from the same simulation (an oracle reference)

run_without_a_score.MHN: notebooks/tool_mhn_bulk.ipynb: 295 patients, 4 events; the fitted Theta network and progression orders are figures only
run_without_a_score.scDEF: notebooks/tool_scdef_cohort.ipynb: 5 patients, 1,500 cells; layer sizes [8, 5, 3, 2, 1, 1]; figures only
